# `jwt`

[External Documentation](https://github.com/auth0/node-jsonwebtoken) 

An implementation of JSON Web Tokens.

#### Example

```javascript

      const token = jwt.sign({ foo: 'bar' }, 'shhhhh');
      $_RETURN_DATA_ = token;
      
```
